events.name: January 1974
events.note: The Brisbane River flood after Cyclone Wanda, backing up Oxley Creek and the creeks along Moorooka's edge. The council's map is of the river flood only.

events.name: January 2011
events.note: The Brisbane River flood of 13 January 2011. The council's map is of the river flood only.

events.name: February 2022
events.note: Three days of record rain. The council mapped both the river and the creeks.

events.name: 1% AEP flood
events.note: A 1 in 100 chance in any year: the council's high and medium likelihood areas for river and creek flooding.

events.name: 2% AEP flood
events.note: A 1 in 50 chance in any year. The council does not map this one: it is worked out between its 5% and 1% maps.

events.name: 5% AEP flood
events.note: A 1 in 20 chance in any year: the council's high likelihood areas for river and creek flooding.

events.name: 0.2% AEP flood
events.note: A 1 in 500 chance in any year: the council's high, medium and low likelihood areas for river and creek flooding.
